mentions.name: Climbable.day
mentions.description: This website helps mountaineers in the Pacific Northwest plan summit trips, covering 500 summits with 20 years of weather data (wind, precipitation, snow cover, temperature). It adds wildfire smoke map overlays from official sources, WSDOT road closures, summit approach information sourced from Peak Beggar and the Mountaineers, a database of known incidents from the AAC, and comparison of plan A/B/C summit options. It is free, non-commercial, and has a couple hundred weekly users in the local community.
mentions.problem: Planning mountaineering trips around unpredictable weather in the Pacific Northwest, such as finding the backup summit with the highest probability of good weather when the primary choice is out due to hazardous conditions.
mentions.audience: Mountaineers from Seattle and around the Pacific Northwest
mentions.source_excerpt:
Ended up building https://climbable.day - hopefully a helpful resource for fellow Mountaineers from Seattle and around. 500 summits, 20 years of weather data, then went all in and added

- Wildfire smoke map overlays from official sources
- Road closures from WSDOT
- Information about approaches to most of the summits, sourced from Peak Beggar and Mountaineers
- Database of known incidents from AAC
- Compare your plan A, plan B, plan C, that type of thing
mentions.author: dreamiurg
